intent: Write three distinct, truthful alarm hooks for viewers who know nothing about the topic.

templates.personal_stake: Your {everyday object} is not as {assumed property} as you think

examples: Your AI chats could end up in court
You deleted it. Who kept a copy?
The privacy promise you need to read
conventions: Keep each title at 60 characters or fewer; make the first 40 count.
Use three different emotions, not the same claim reworded.
Use natural sentence case and reserve capitals for a key word.
Write the actual risk: could or almost when the event did not happen.
sounds_false: Discover the fascinating revolution that changes EVERYTHING.
You are next: a universal prediction without evidence.
A technical acronym before the viewer knows the stakes.
